title: Alexander and United bands march on to UIL state contest
excerpt: Two United ISD high school marching bands — Alexander and United — have earned spots at the UIL 6A State Marching Band Contest on Monday, November 9, at the Alamodome in San Antonio.
content:
Two United Independent School District high school marching bands are headed to the state’s biggest stage. J.B. Alexander High School and United High School both earned spots at the UIL 6A State Marching Band Contest after strong performances at the UIL Area G 6A Marching Band Contest, according to United ISD.

Among 16 competing bands, Alexander and United finished first and second, respectively, in the preliminary round and advanced to the finals. Alexander went on to claim first place and the UIL Area G Championship, while United secured third place, earning the district two of the three available qualifying spots for state.

The win marks Alexander High School band’s fifth UIL Area G Championship and its eighth consecutive trip to the State Marching Contest. The program’s 325 students are led by head band director Ricardo Fuentes, who said the character developed, the relationships formed and the lives changed through the experience will endure long after the final performance.

For the Mighty Longhorn Band, the result marks a return to the state stage for the first time since 2023 and the program’s fifth trip in school history. United High School head band director Samuel Hjort credited the students’ dedication and the foundation built by the program’s former leadership, middle school music educators and supportive families.

Alexander and United have advanced to the State Marching Contest together only twice before, in 2018 and 2023. Their third shared appearance is another proud moment for both schools and the Laredo community, the district said.

The UIL 6A State Marching Band Contest takes place Monday, November 9, at the Alamodome in San Antonio. The Longhorn Band is scheduled to perform at 11:45 a.m., and the Bulldog Band takes the field at 9:00 p.m. later that day.

The community is invited to wish both bands well at send-offs scheduled for Sunday, November 8. The United High School lineup begins at 11:30 a.m. along International Boulevard near the school, and Alexander lines up at the Student Activity Complex along Santa Claudia Lane beginning at 3:30 p.m. Supporters are asked to bring signs and make some noise for the state-bound bands.

Source: United Independent School District, November 5, 2026.
